annotations.text:
Direction A: quiet operations console.
Kept: Inter, brand blue #0066CC, slate #0F1729, 8px radius, 224px sidebar, shadcn card/badge/button anatomy.
Added: 48px utility bar (breadcrumb, global search ⌘K, environment chip), grouped sidebar with org + AI-credit meter, KPI strip with deltas and sparklines, toolbar row (segmented filter + search + filter chips + density toggle), tables with uppercase 11px headers, tabular numerals, status dots and soft pills, one consolidated Export action per page.

SOW dashboard, what changed and why:
1. Red 0/12/29 numbers read as errors; risk score now has a neutral value + trend arrow, completeness shows '–' when not reviewed.
2. Five text links per row (Review · View · New version · Compare · Delete) became one Review button + overflow menu; destructive action moves into the menu.
3. Project groups get summary chips (avg score, critical count) in a real header row instead of right-aligned loose text.
4. Counts row (Total 11 · SOW 9 …) became a segmented filter that actually filters.
5. KPI strip gives the page a purpose above the table.

MITRE list: cards hid comparison. A table with inline coverage bars per domain, covered/applicable, trend delta and last run lets a consultant scan four customers at once. Card view stays as a toggle.
MITRE detail: eight equal tiles flattened the story. Now 6 tiles with hierarchy, the tool-overlay banner reads as 'two numbers, never one', inputs sit in two cards with a chip vocabulary (tagged / AI-tagged / unmapped / disabled), Exec PDF · Full PDF · XLSX · PPT · Navigator collapse into one Export menu. Heatmap unchanged in logic, legend moved into the toolbar.

Code Security Review detail: added a 'where to start' strip (the set-cover result the PPTX already computes), 'in N chains' pill on findings that matter most, a Remediation plan tab, and the VVAH attribution moved to the table footer. Severity became a pill, confidence a bar, file:lines mono.
Admin: organisations table now leads with the decision (Enable pro), shows access requests inline with age, and the AI provider card surfaces the OpenRouter key state that caused today's outage.

Two genuinely different directions, sketched low-fi so the choice is about structure, not polish. Direction A (page 1) is the recommendation: it keeps every existing token and component, so it can be built incrementally page by page.
